title: GTA 6 Lacks Mission Replay, But Features Easier Fail States
description: Rockstar's GTA 6 will not allow players to replay completed missions, a shift from GTA 5, though multiple save files and easier fail states help balance the experience.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Drops Mission Replay: Why Rockstar Changed the Formula

Players diving into *Grand Theft Auto 6* will encounter a notable shift in how the game handles its campaign: you cannot replay missions once they have been completed. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, this feature, which has been a staple in Rockstar games as recently as *GTA 5*, is entirely absent in the new title. A reviewer who spent over 100 hours with the game confirmed that once you make progress in the story, that portion of the narrative is locked in place, with no option to jump back in via a mission select menu.

### Adapting to a New Structure

The absence of a mission replay option might come as a shock to fans who enjoyed chasing gold medals or revisiting set-pieces. However, Rockstar has reportedly made missions "harder to fail" to compensate for this design choice. By adjusting the difficulty and friction within the missions themselves, the developers aim to make the initial playthrough smoother and less punishing.

To manage the inability to replay specific moments, players are encouraged to rely on **multiple save files**. Setting up distinct saves at crucial story junctures will be the primary method for anyone wanting to revisit specific scenarios without starting a brand-new game from scratch.

### Editor's Take

Dropping the mission replay feature is a risky design pivot for Rockstar, especially after it became a beloved standard in modern open-world games. While making missions harder to fail and encouraging multiple save files softens the blow, players will definitely need to adopt a more mindful approach to their campaign progression this time around.
